golem republish of OTA-1642 to exercise the Sentry release step (task #109)

Same bundle as c72cdbec — no app change, one note beside the stamp. The
Actions dispatch is not reachable from this session (403 on the dispatch
endpoint), and the new Sentry step only runs inside a publish, so this
markerless golem push is the measurement: the run log will say whether
SENTRY_READ_TOKEN already carries project:releases or a SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN
secret is needed.
